Presentation controls

Right, Space, or Page Down advances an animation state, then the slide.
Left or Page Up reverses the animation states.
F opens fullscreen. P opens presenter notes in a regular tab.
Shift+P opens presenter notes in this tab.
B opens slides and backups. End returns to the conclusion.

The main talk stops on slide 17. Open backups from the menu.
Graph positions stay fixed through each trace. Blue passes the filter. Orange fails. Gray marks untested or inactive entries.
GPU examples zoom into a few lanes of a 32-thread warp.

Bullet note edits save automatically. Open Q&A for short answers, or search across the deck. Earlier notes remain available and can be exported. Save notes saves immediately; Export notes downloads the current bullets and Q&A.
Use the local launcher for reliable synchronization between audience and presenter windows.
